derry_tower_guide.text: Welcome to the Tower Museum. We tell the story of Derry~Londonderry from the first oak grove to the present day.
One of our treasures is from La Trinidad Valencera, an Armada ship. She sank off Inishowen in 1588, and divers found her in 1971.
Do try the story gallery. Nobody has ever got through it quickly, and nobody has ever minded.

derry_tower_student.text: I am here for a school project and I have stayed for the cafe. Both are going well.
